name: pr-inbox
description: A review inbox for the current repo's open PRs: who is waiting on you, what changed since your review, unresolved threads with their code, one key to open, explain or review.

pollMinutes.title: Poll interval
pollMinutes.description: Minutes between refreshes while the inbox is on.

reviewCommand.title: Review command
reviewCommand.description: Typed into the prompt by r. {n} is the PR number.

reReviewCommand.title: Re-review command
reReviewCommand.description: Typed by r on a PR that moved since your review. {n} is the PR number, {sha} the commit your review sits on.

explainCommand.title: Explain command
explainCommand.description: Typed into the prompt by e. {n} is the PR number.
